review_unit: One deterministic pair for each of 25 cross-community families in the first 50 discovery-selected photos. Within each family, choose earliest selected parent per community, breaking region ties by descending affinity; retain the first two different communities.
reviewer: Single multimodal agent; same research workflow, not independent human annotation.
review_material: Original parent images with SHA-256 validation and exact stored masks with mask hash validation; enlarged region crops; all 25 pairs inspected.
meaning: Supported means a shared visible surface, part, or condition in this selected pair. It does not mean new scientific discovery, a homologous component, new product category, or physical recycling utility. Some pairs are generic same-product parts and two use a product composition rather than two field photographs.
scope: This audit describes the fixed discovery selection. It is not a fair comparative semantic-precision benchmark because the comparator selections were not adjudicated in this follow-up.
mechanism_decision: Keep family coverage as an exploration objective. Do not use census-level names or coherence ratings to certify every selected region. Instance-level pair review is required before exporting a semantic bridge as accepted evidence. Preserve rejected and ambiguous pairs in the dossier rather than presenting all 25 as verified bridges.
source_control: Existing exposure source-control metrics exclude zero test photos using available development pHash links. They establish neither complete source independence nor immunity to unrecorded duplicates. Community-controlled AUROC retains its narrower interpretation.
unchanged: No embeddings, masks, partitions, existing ratings, frozen inspection orders, relation predictions or negative configuration results were overwritten.
